intents.description: Automatic time tracking feature that captures work hours without manual entry
answers: Hourmaker's automatic time tracking captures work hours in real-time without any manual entry. It detects your active work, tracks time in the background, and even has idle time detection to ensure accuracy.
Our automatic tracking feature works silently in the background, logging time based on your activity. It includes smart idle detection and auto-pauses when you step away, ensuring 98% accuracy.
With automatic time tracking, you never need to start or stop timers manually. The system detects when you're working on tasks and projects, automatically logging every billable minute.

Hourmaker's manual time tracking offers an intuitive timesheet interface with smart copy functionality, bulk entry options, and multi-level approval workflows. You can submit weekly, bi-weekly, or monthly timesheets.
Our manual timesheet feature allows you to log hours with minimal clicks. You can copy previous days, use templates for recurring tasks, and managers can approve or reject entries with comments.

The timesheet module supports flexible entry periods, bulk operations for managers, and seamless integration with payroll systems. It's designed for teams that prefer manual entry with complete audit trails.

intents.description: Leave requests, attendance tracking, and time-off management
answers: Hourmaker provides comprehensive leave and attendance management with multiple leave types (PTO, sick, casual, earned), automatic balance calculation, shift management, and overtime tracking. Employees can request leave online with manager approval workflows.

Our attendance module supports multiple check-in methods including web-based check-ins. You can manage shifts, track overtime, and enforce leave policies automatically. Leave balances update in real-time with automatic accruals.

The leave and attendance system includes holiday integration, automatic overtime calculation, shift management for rotating schedules, and complete audit trails for compliance. Managers get real-time visibility into attendance patterns.

intents.description: Employee scheduling, shift planning, and staff allocation
answers: Hourmaker's intelligent scheduling allows you to create, manage, and optimize employee schedules with drag-and-drop functionality. Features include shift templates, conflict detection, employee availability tracking, and real-time notifications.

Our scheduling module helps you create shift rosters, manage shift swaps, and ensure adequate coverage. You can set recurring schedules, track employee availability, and get alerts for potential conflicts or overtime.

With smart scheduling, you can forecast staffing needs, manage rotating shifts, and allow employees to request shift swaps. The system automatically detects double-bookings and sends schedule updates to your team.

intents.description: Project-based time tracking, budgets, and profitability
answers: Hourmaker's project tracking lets you monitor project hours, budgets, and progress in real-time. Features include task-level time breakdown, budget alerts, resource allocation views, and profitability analysis for every project.

Our project management module helps you create projects with budgets and deadlines, assign tasks to team members, track time against specific tasks, and get real-time alerts when projects approach budget limits.

With project tracking, you can see exactly how time is being spent across tasks, identify underutilized resources, and analyze project profitability. The system includes milestone tracking and Gantt chart views for timeline management.

intents.description: Billing management, invoicing, and payment tracking
answers: Hourmaker's billing module automates invoice generation from approved timesheets. Features include multi-rate billing, expense tracking, recurring invoices, and automated payment reminders to improve cash flow.

Our invoicing system lets you create professional invoices with customizable templates. You can set up recurring invoices for retainer clients, embed payment links directly in invoices, and track payment status in real-time.

With automated billing, you can generate invoices automatically from tracked time, configure different billing rates per client or project, and get real-time insights into revenue and accounts receivable.

Hourmaker offers powerful reporting and analytics with pre-built reports for productivity, utilization, and profitability. You can build custom reports with our drag-and-drop report builder and create interactive dashboards.

Our analytics module provides real-time KPI monitoring, trend analysis, and resource utilization insights. You can export reports in multiple formats (PDF, Excel, CSV) and schedule automated report delivery.
With custom dashboards, you can visualize your workforce data exactly how you need it. Track key metrics in real-time, identify patterns, and make data-driven decisions with comprehensive analytics.

With digital onboarding, you can collect documents electronically, automate policy acknowledgments, and track onboarding progress. The system reduces time-to-productivity by 45% and cuts administrative work by 70%.

intents.description: Cloud document repository and file management
answers: Hourmaker's cloud document portal provides secure, encrypted storage for all your business documents. You can organize files with folders and tags, control access permissions, and share documents securely with expiry links.
Our document repository lets you store employee contracts, company policies, and important files in one central location. Features include secure sharing, download restrictions, and automatic backup.

With smart organization, you can tag employees to specific documents, control who can view or edit, and access your files from anywhere on any device. All documents are encrypted with enterprise-grade security.

intents.description: User permissions and role-based access control
answers: Hourmaker provides granular role-based access control with custom roles and permissions. You can control access at the module level, restrict data visibility by department, and manage complete audit trails of all access changes.
Our access management system lets you create custom roles with specific permissions, set up manager hierarchies for approvals, and enforce security policies across your organization.
With role-based access, you can ensure users only see what they need. Features include module-level control, data restrictions, and comprehensive audit logs for compliance requirements.

Hourmaker's user management system allows you to add, update, or deactivate users in bulk. Features include CSV import, department management, employee directories, and complete user lifecycle automation from onboarding to offboarding.
Our user administration tools let you manage all employees from one place. You can organize by departments, set reporting hierarchies, add custom fields to profiles, and track user activity logs.
With centralized user management, you can quickly add team members, assign roles, and maintain a searchable employee directory with contact information, skills tracking, and emergency contacts.

intents.description: Holiday calendar and regional holiday management
answers: Hourmaker's holiday calendar lets you manage company-wide and regional holidays with ease. The system automatically adjusts leave balances and attendance rules for holidays, and employees can see upcoming holidays in advance.

Our holiday management module supports multiple locations with different holiday lists. You can configure holiday types (mandatory, optional), track holiday work hours, and automatically apply premium rates.
With holiday integration, leave balances adjust automatically when holidays fall on workdays. The system also tracks holiday work and applies compensatory off or premium rates based on your policies.

Hourmaker's meeting scheduler eliminates back-and-forth emails. You can share availability, let others book time, and automatically generate video conference links. Features include calendar sync and automated reminders.
Our scheduling tool integrates with Google Calendar, Outlook, and other calendars. You can book meeting rooms, set up recurring meetings, and send automatic reminders to reduce no-shows.
With smart meeting scheduling, you can share your availability without exposing calendar details, let people book based on your preferences, and sync all meetings automatically across your calendars.

intents.description: Client portal and client relationship management
answers: Hourmaker's client portal gives your clients secure, branded access to view project status, timesheets, and invoices. You control exactly what they can see, from high-level progress to detailed time entries.

Our client management features let you share documents securely, collect digital approvals, and maintain centralized communication with each client. Clients can review and approve timesheets directly.
With client portals, you can provide transparency while maintaining control. Clients can view and pay invoices online, give feedback, and see project updates without needing to email you for status.

Hourmaker provides flexible approval workflows with multi-level hierarchies, parallel and sequential paths, and automatic escalation. You can configure custom approval rules by department or project type.

Our approval system supports timesheet approvals, leave approvals, expense approvals, and schedule changes. Managers can approve, reject, or request changes with comments, and all actions are tracked in audit logs.
With automated workflows, pending approvals escalate automatically if not reviewed on time. You can set up delegation rules for out-of-office periods and configure email notifications for approvers.
